name: Pampa River
description: Peaceful boating facilities right at the temple foothills with scenic views of the Ratnagiri hill.

name: Tuni (Talupulamma Thalli Devasthanam)
description: Sri Talupulamma Thalli Devasthanam, a very popular and revered hill-slope shrine.

name: Pithapuram
description: Famous for the ancient Pada Gaya Sarovaram sacred tank and Sri Puruhutika Devi Shakti Peetha.

name: Samarlakota (Kumararama Bhimeswara Swamy Temple)
description: Ancient 9th-century Pancharama Kshetra dedicated to Lord Siva (Kumararama Bhimeswara Swamy).

name: Kakinada
description: Port city famous for scenic beach parks, Hope Island, and the world-famous Kakinada Kaaja sweet.

name: Uppada Beach
description: Scenic Uppada Beach and famous traditional handloom Uppada Jamdani Silk Weaving Village.

name: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense mangrove forest offering wooden boardwalks, birdwatching, and boat safaris.

name: Rajahmundry
description: Cultural capital of Andhra Pradesh, famous for Godavari River ghats, bridges, and river cruises.

name: Draksharamam (Bhimeswara Swamy Temple)
description: Ancient Bhimeswara Swamy Temple, revered both as a prominent Pancharama Kshetram and a powerful Shakti Peetha (Manikyamba Devi).
